skill.summary: Build Remix games for remix.gg with the server-api v1 agents REST API and Farcade game SDK requirements.

latestVersion.changelog:
remix-agent-publish v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill.
- Provides guidance for automating game publishing to remix.gg via server-api v1 agents REST API and Farcade game SDK.
- Includes best practices, validation rules, and references for 2D and 3D game development.
- Offers workflow guardrails, REST client code snippets, and clear source of truth for API integration.
